objective: Produce a source-anchored structural architecture map of the admitted inference-fabric modules
prompt: Return only strict JSON using schema giga.architecture-map.v1. Top-level fields must be schema, project, source_packet_sha256, components, edges and risks. Map every admitted Python module exactly once. Each component needs id, responsibility and one or more path:line sources. Record every direct internal import between admitted modules as an edge with from, to, kind=imports, confidence=certain and one or more path:line evidence anchors. Add two to eight concrete architectural risks; risk confidence must be inferred or low, never certain. Do not cite files outside the bound packet and do not use Markdown.
